clock: clk; actual owning local domain, no derived clock
reset: rst_n; actual cold-link coordinated reset only
input_acceptance: in_v && in_r at rising clk; producer must preserve unaccepted data
permission: all 14 banks normal; final stage empty or consumer ready allows global shift
quiet: all banks normal and every stage valid bit zero; repair or fault suppresses quiet
fault: any bank uncorrectable data error, protected repair-controller error, or fault rail mismatch; propagated sticky across all banks
repair: each CE freezes global transfer; bank protected five-phase correction; output data corrected combinationally so held output payload stays unchanged during a single-bit output upset
valid_during_repair: out_v deasserts; consumer must use actual valid/ready handshake, never infer irrevocable validity from a prior cycle
nominal_latency: 14 edges from accepted input to earliest output retirement; each global stall adds one edge
credits: component does not create or return credits; global reservation covers all occupied stages; only final native RX packet retirement returns credit
reset_caution: reset discards data and never authorizes credit return; lifecycle controller must prove/quarantine prior generation flight
physical_status: unqualified; 1.2 GHz SS/FF timing and encoded storage retention require measurement
